Living tribal community

Meskwaki Settlement

The Meskwaki Settlement is the Meskwaki Nation’s community near Tama, Iowa. Tribal members began buying land in Tama County in 1857 and built the settlement on land they acquired.

Establishing the settlement

The State Historical Society of Iowa documents the 1857 purchase. The Nation’s account connects the purchase to the community it maintains in Tama County today.
